about: Editor spec §51, spec_version_in_files: a graph may name the Graph Spec version it is written to on its graph line, as '· spec 1.0'. A reader reads a block written to its own major Graph Spec, an older one, or none named. It refuses a newer major with GN107 and a fix that says to upgrade, and the note's text is kept as written. One table for both readers: spec-version.test.mjs and python/graph_spec/tests/test_spec_version.py.
